svg.title: Figure 1-5: "Model as Agent" Architecture—Native Tool Calling
svg.desc: The LLM calls native tools such as web_search and code_interpreter in a closed loop run by the server-side Harness. User input and final output sit outside that loop; inside it, Thought, Action and Observation form the ReAct cycle.
